query: How should we operationalise saturation: specify coding unit, analytic software/workflow, stopping metrics (e.g., no new core codes after X sessions or code-accumulation curve thresholds)?

response.query: How should we operationalise saturation: specify coding unit, analytic software/workflow, stopping metrics (e.g., no new core codes after X sessions or code-accumulation curve thresholds)?
response.answer: To operationalize saturation, use a coding unit of data segments, employ qualitative software like NVivo, and stop when no new core codes emerge after 10-15 sessions or when code-accumulation curves flatten.
